# TPC-DS-OBT Q96

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    sold_time_sk = sold_time_t_time_sk
    AND ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
    AND store_sk = store_s_store_sk
    AND sold_time_t_hour = 20
    AND sold_time_t_minute >= 30
    AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 0
    AND store_s_store_name = 'ese'
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
```
